notes: 可以连接多个自己的 AI，各自保留连接，轮流操作同一部手机；已有单 AI 连接可在手机上开启多 AI 模式并保留原连接。
手机息屏时，正常读屏和操作请求会尝试自动亮屏，再继续任务。系统要求密码或生物识别时仍需本人验证，不会绕过。
改进后台连接恢复：收到中继确认后才显示已连接；断网或长时间无响应后会重试原连接，不自动重放结果未知的手机操作。
近期版本可直接覆盖更新，保留数据和有效配对，不要先卸载或清除数据。极早预览版若显示“开始新版连接”，按提示为这台手机重新邀请和核码；主动停止或解除连接后不会自动恢复。
Muse 与 Instinct 已在魅族 Note 16 上分别完成息屏任务，并完成有限范围的双 AI 互斥交接；失败、恢复及证据限制另有记录。更多机型、独立新用户首用和多日无人值守仍待验证。

apk_preparation.signature_check: apksigner verify with expected long-term release certificate
apk_preparation.source_limit: The original build froze file hashes while version metadata was uncommitted. Current production Android inputs match those frozen bytes; this does not claim the full original worktree was a clean Git commit or that a rebuild is bit-for-bit reproducible.

installation.scope: Existing prepared phone and old UI; first installation, first permission approval, invitation sending and code confirmation were not fully recorded.

usage.scope: Historical Muse route-to-notes task; USB coordination/recording, temporary charging keep-awake and edited waits remain disclosed.

rollout_scope: Candidate metadata and one frozen website build are prepared for review. Actual recommendation switching and public HTTP verification are separate operations; this record alone does not announce publication.
not_verified: Independent newcomer installation and full first use
Genuine independent-runtime recreation unless separately recorded
More phone models, pure mobile-network full tasks and multi-day unattended endurance
Another phone migration or retirement of its previous control route
privacy_scope: Public metadata and aggregate results only. No signing secrets, configuration, pairing data, raw phone screenshots, private chats, private deployment paths or addresses.
upgrade_boundary: Existing protocol4 connections should be retained by normal same-signature upgrade. Much earlier protocol preview installations may require the explicit in-app new-connection flow and normal approval; application data preservation is not preservation of an obsolete transient control grant. No uninstall or cross-device profile copy is instructed.
